newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Kalbe Farma rises on Q1 reports.
newsitem.headline: Kalbe Farma rises on Q1 reports.

text.p: Indonesian pharmaceutical manufacturer PT Kalbe Farma rose about 6.3 percent in active trading on Tuesday on newspaper reports that it would announce positive first quarter results, brokers said.
At 0825 GMT, the share was up 175 rupiah at 2,775 rupiah with about 2.2 million shares changing hands.
"I think growing sentiment on Kalbe Farma is linked to the newspaper report on its first quarter results," an analyst with a foreign firm said.

The Indonesian Observer said on Tuesday the firm was likely to reach a net profit of 21 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997. The report said the firm was expecting to book a full year net profit of 83.4 billion rupiah.
The newspaper also quoted Kalbe Farma executives as saying that the company's sales in first quarter increased by 10 percent against sales in the same period in 1996.
The company has not announced first quarter results yet. The firm booked net income of 73.11 billion rupiah in 1996 against 65.27 billion rupiah in 1995.
A Kalbe Farma executive declined comment on the newspaper report but said the firm's earnings would show an improvement this year over 1996 because of an ongoing restructuring programme.
